subject: humanities
passage: Most painters work with a brush on a canvas that stands upright on an easel, but some artists have found very different ways to apply paint. ______ the American painter Jackson Pollock often spread his canvas flat on the floor of his studio and dripped or poured paint onto it from sticks and cans.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The first sentence ends by saying that some artists have found "very different ways to apply paint." The second sentence describes one artist who did so: Pollock dripped and poured paint onto a canvas on the floor. A transition that introduces an example is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Other artists' methods did not cause Pollock's method; his method is one case of them.
explanation.B: Correct. "For instance" introduces Pollock as one artist who found a very different way to apply paint.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Similarly" would compare Pollock to an artist already described, but no particular artist has been described yet.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Pollock's method agrees with the idea that some artists work differently, so there is no contrast.
